messages:
Jess: Mini-standup — quick updates: what you did / blockers / today. Trying to unblock the routing canary by EOD.

Arun: Merged telemetry schema change; waiting on QA for embed-cache verification. Today: client retry backoff work. Ping @Maya for QA creds.

Maya: Got creds, running smoke now. Seeing occasional 503 on long streaming requests. Log snippet:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"input":"..."}'
# response: 503 Service Temporarily Unavailable
```
Will rerun with increased timeout.

Leo: WIP: routing fallback policy doc. Blocker: need rollout percentages from PM to populate canary config. @Jess propose 5/20/75?

Jess: That split sounds good. Start with conservative 5% canary in us-west and hold for 2 hours, raise if errors <0.5% :thumbsup:

Arun: Heads-up on CRs: #2346 (telemetry) small, #2350 (retry backoff) needs review. If someone picks up 2350 I can merge and trigger the canary.

Maya: I can review 2350 after smoke passes. Will post results here.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued for routing-v2; waiting on approvals from product and oncall.

Leo: Also adding new metric names to the console dashboard and the rollout runbook in a minute.

Jess: One blocker from legal on data retention wording for Private deployments — @Sam can you take a look later today?

Sam: Yup — send the draft snippet, I'll review this afternoon.

Jess: Thanks all — updates here by EOD. If smoke fails, we'll roll back and open incident channel.
